newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SETS UP NORTH AMERICAN HEADQUARTERS.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SETS UP NORTH AMERICAN HEADQUARTERS.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it had decided to create a North American regional headquarters.
Mike Oakley, currently chairman of Philips' medical systems division, will become regional executive for the U.S., Canada and Mexico from April 1 of this year.
Moakley will also become president and chief executive officer of Philips Electronics North America Corp (PENAC). He will report to Philips' vice-chairman Dudley Eustace.
Hans Barella will succeed Oakley as chairman of the medical systems division, Philips said.
